data.caption:
Delhi me sardi badhte hi ando ke daam aasmaan chhoone lage hain! 🥚🥶

• Sardi shuru hote hi Delhi me ando ke daam me bada ucchal aaya
• 30 ando wali crate par lagbhag 20 rupaye tak badh gaye daam
• Sardi me high demand ki wajah se daam tezi se badhe hain

Gym walo ka protein budget to gaya kaam se! 😂

Apne us gym wale dost ko tag karo jiska diet budget hilne wala hai!
